description: Read-only. List YOUR comparison zones (Jämförelseobjekt — your clones of a Sedis-owned aggregate), returning each zone's `sedisId`. This is the FIRST step of the §8 A6 flow: find a zone by name here, then pass its `sedisId` to `fastighetsbenchmark_search_property_units` as `belongsToJamforelseobjektSedisId` to find your units in it. Lean by default: set `detail: true` to opt into the tenant-filtered `containsPropertyUnits` lineage. Example: nameContains 'Stockholm'. Tenant-scoped to your data; read-only — never writes.

detail.description: false (default, lean) omits lineage; true opts the tenant-filtered containsPropertyUnits array in via ?fields=.

pageSize.description: Rows per page (v2 default 50, max 500), e.g. 50.

sort.description: Comma-separated sort fields; prefix '-' for descending, e.g. '-name'.

name: fastighetsbenchmark_list_jamforelseobjekt

name.description: Referenced Comp display name, e.g. 'Office tower 1'.

sedisId.description: Referenced Comp sedisId; resolve via get_comp_timeseries / search, e.g. 'PU-1'.

containsPropertyUnits.description: Forward clone lineage — YOUR property units in this clone's source SedisObjekt; present ONLY when detail=true. Tenant-filtered.

sedisId.description: Comparison-zone sedisId; use as belongsToJamforelseobjektSedisId in search_property_units, e.g. 'JO-A'.

pageSize.description: Rows per page echoed back by v2, e.g. 50.

totalCount.description: Total matching rows across all pages; null/absent when count is skipped.

totalPages.description: Total page count; null/absent when count is skipped.

title: List your comparison zones (Jämförelseobjekt)
